component.name: Bonk! Model Prop-inator!
component.summary: Build Garry's Mod props from brushes, Hammer style

description.p: Bonk! is a brush modeler for Source engine props: draw blocks, cylinders, wedges and arches in four Hammer-style views, texture them, and compile them into a model for Garry's Mod with the game's own studiomdl (run through Proton).

ul.li: Hammer-style editing: blocks, primitives, vertex editing, clipping, grouping and layers
Textures from images, with Source material properties, animation and live VMTs
Collision models: complex, or simplified automatically, and a walk mode to try them
Skins, bodygroups and levels of detail, with a model preview
Prefabs, spawnlists with spawn icons, and the standalone Spawnlist Creator
Export to the Garry's Mod addons folder and publish to the Steam Workshop

description.p: Simple and Advanced modes, walk mode, the Spawnlist Creator, models from other addons in spawnlists, sharper simplified collision, fly speed settings and many fixes.
Publishing opens the addon's Workshop page when it's done.
